Probe.//CollectorEndpoint: The collector on your LAN. One collector serves every server.
Probe.//ProbeKey: Must match the collector's Probe:Key. Prefer the CONTOSO_PROBE_KEY env var.
Probe.//ServerName: Defaults to the machine name. Set it if this box was cloned from an image.
Probe.//ScrapeInterval: Only used before the first successful POST; the collector sets it after that.
